title: gentiana asclepiadea var. plicata
intro: Gentiana asclepiadea var. plicata, commonly known as Frill gentian or Plicata gentian, is a variant of the Gentiana asclepiadea plant, which belongs to the Gentianaceae family. This perennial plant is native to the mountainous regions of Europe and is valued for its medicinal properties and ornamental value. The health benefits of Gentiana asclepiadea var. plicata include its potential to support respiratory health, reduce inflammation, and exhibit antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of this plant are attributed to its bioactive constituents, which include gentiopicrin, gentianine, and amarogentin, that have been traditionally used to treat digestive issues and respiratory problems.
